Watts made this hymn from Psalm 23, "in the language of the New Testament": a paraphrase, not a translation. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

1The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want. 2He makes me lie down in green pastures; He leads me beside quiet waters. 3He restores my soul; He guides me in the paths of righteousness for the sake of His name. 4Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me. … 2 more verses PSALM 23 · ITS FIRST VERSES · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ PSALM 23
My shepherd will supply my need, Jehovah is his name; In pastures fresh he makes me feed, Beside the living stream. STANZA I
Watts's psalms run from Psalm 1 to Psalm 150, several settings to many psalms: 367 hymns. This is number 23. Point at a tick to see the hymn; click it to open that hymn.
